scoring_justification: Full DFT recomputation is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; result-level comparison against paper-reported values is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold band gap values from Table 1 of the source paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1: FP-LAPW indirect 1.87 eV, direct 2.24 eV; FP-LAPW+SA indirect 3.2 eV, direct 3.57 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed from Table 1 of the original publication and embedded inline.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact reported values for the same computational conditions.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold epsilon2 peak energies A-I from Table 2 of the source paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed from Table 2 of the original publication and embedded inline.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact reported peak positions for the scissor-corrected calculation.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold static dielectric constant epsilon1(0)=5.35 and plasma peak 28 eV from the paper text and figures.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Section 3.2 and Fig. 3: epsilon1(0)=5.35, plasma peak=28 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's results and discussion; embedded inline.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact reported values for the same FP-LAPW-SA calculation.

outputs.description: Direct and indirect band gaps (raw GGA and after 1.33 eV scissor correction).
Positions of the nine major peaks (A–I) in ε₂(ω) between 0 and 30 eV.
Static dielectric constant ε₁(0) and energy of the plasma peak in L(ω).

output_contract.notes: All quantities are fixed physical properties obtained from a first‑principles DFT workflow; the checker compares each value to the paper‑reported reference within hidden tolerances (result‑level compare, T0). No metrics are “better” than the reference, so exact_match is the appropriate target policy.
